about: Synthetic, held-out evaluation of app guide search (docs/APP_GUIDES.md). Original text written for this test: a fictional game wiki and an image editor's help pages, with the kind of pages that mention everything in passing (a main page, a beginner's guide, patch notes, item lists, achievements, a tools overview, a glossary). Each question names what answers it: a page title, or 'Page › Section' when one section does. Questions marked tune were used to choose the ranking weights; held-out ones were not. offTopic is chat that is about neither guide.

pages.title: Iron Ore
lines: # Iron Ore
Iron Ore is a common crafting material in Emberfall. It is the base of most early weapons, armor and tools.
## Locations

Iron Ore veins appear as grey rocks with rust-colored streaks. They are found in the Northern Caves, along the cliffs east of Riverwood and in the Old Quarry. A vein gives two to four pieces when struck with a pickaxe and respawns after three in-game days.
## Buying
Brannoc the blacksmith in Riverwood sells Iron Ore for 7 gold each and restocks every Monday. Traveling merchants on the King's Road sometimes carry it for 9 gold.
## Uses
Two Iron Ore are smelted into one Iron Ingot at any smelter. Iron Ore is also used directly to repair iron tools at a workbench.

pages.title: Copper Ore
lines: # Copper Ore
Copper Ore is the first metal most players collect. It is softer than iron and is used for basic tools and wiring.
## Locations
Copper veins are orange-green rocks found on the surface near Millbrook Farm, in the Sunken Mine and in shallow caves along the southern coast. They can be mined with any pickaxe, even the stone one.
## Uses
Smelt three Copper Ore into a Copper Ingot. Copper Ingots are needed for the copper pickaxe, lanterns and the first backpack upgrade.

pages.title: Gold Ore
lines: # Gold Ore
Gold Ore is a rare metal used for jewelry and enchanting.
## Locations
Gold veins glitter yellow and only appear deep in the Northern Caves below level three and in the Ashen Peaks. You need at least an iron pickaxe to mine them.
## Uses
Gold Ingots are used to craft rings and amulets and to enchant weapons at the Arcane Table. A gold ingot sells for 60 gold.

pages.title: Iron Ingot
lines: # Iron Ingot
An Iron Ingot is a refined bar of iron used at the anvil.
## How to make
Place two Iron Ore and one piece of coal in a smelter. Smelting takes about one in-game hour. You can also buy Iron Ingots from Brannoc for 20 gold.
## Used in
Iron Sword, Iron Helmet, Iron Pickaxe, nails, the Reinforced Door and the Steel Ingot recipe.

pages.title: Smelter
lines: # Smelter
A Smelter turns ore into ingots and sand into glass.
## Building a smelter
Build a smelter at a workbench with 20 stone, 5 clay and 2 copper ingots. It must be placed outdoors or under a chimney.
## Fuel
Smelters burn wood, charcoal or coal. Coal lasts four times longer than wood and is required for steel.
## Recipes
- Copper Ingot: 3 Copper Ore
- Iron Ingot: 2 Iron Ore and 1 coal
- Steel Ingot: 1 Iron Ingot and 2 coal
- Glass: 4 sand

pages.title: Brannoc the Blacksmith
lines: # Brannoc the Blacksmith
Brannoc runs the forge in Riverwood, next to the mill by the river bridge.
## Shop
He sells ore, ingots, iron weapons and armor. His shop is open from 8 in the morning to 6 in the evening, and closed on Sundays.
## Upgrading weapons

Brannoc can upgrade a weapon up to +5. Each level costs ingots of the weapon's metal and gold: +1 costs one ingot and 50 gold, and each level after doubles the cost. You can also upgrade weapons yourself at an anvil once you learn the Smithing skill.
## Friendship
Giving Brannoc a Dragon Scale or a cooked trout raises his friendship. At five hearts he offers a ten percent discount.

pages.title: Riverwood
lines: # Riverwood
Riverwood is the starting village of Emberfall, in the green valley south of the Northern Caves.
## Places
- The Forge, run by Brannoc the blacksmith
- The Sleeping Fox inn, where you can rent a bed for 10 gold
- The general store, which sells seeds, food and torches
- The fast travel shrine in the village square
## Getting there
From the Northern Caves, follow the river south for about two minutes. The King's Road connects Riverwood to the capital in the east.

pages.title: Northern Caves
lines: # Northern Caves
The Northern Caves are a large cave system north of Riverwood, with five levels.
## How to get there
Leave Riverwood by the north gate and follow the river upstream. The entrance is a dark opening behind the waterfall.
## Levels
Levels one and two have copper and iron. Level three and below have gold veins, crystal bats and the Frost Wolves' den. The Fire Giant waits on level five.
## Tips
Bring a lantern or torches: the caves are completely dark below level one. Cave spiders are weak to fire.

pages.title: Pickaxe
lines: # Pickaxe
A pickaxe is the tool used to mine rocks and ore veins.
## Types
- Stone Pickaxe: mines stone and copper
- Copper Pickaxe: mines iron
- Iron Pickaxe: mines gold and crystal
- Steel Pickaxe: mines everything and swings faster
## Which is best
The Steel Pickaxe is the best pickaxe in the game. It mines every ore and uses less stamina per swing. Make it at an anvil with three Steel Ingots and two wood.

pages.title: Mining
lines: # Mining
Mining is a skill raised by breaking rocks and ore veins.
## Leveling
Each vein mined gives mining experience. Rarer ores give more. At level 5 veins drop an extra piece of ore, and at level 10 you can see veins through walls.
## Stamina cost
Every swing of a pickaxe costs stamina. Better pickaxes cost less stamina per swing.

pages.title: Iron Sword
lines: # Iron Sword
The Iron Sword is a reliable one-handed weapon with 14 damage.
## Crafting
Forge it at an anvil with two Iron Ingots and one leather strip.
## Upgrades
It can be upgraded up to +5 at the blacksmith, adding 2 damage for each level.

pages.title: Steel Sword
lines: # Steel Sword
The Steel Sword deals 22 damage and is stronger than any iron weapon.
## Crafting
Forge it at an anvil with three Steel Ingots and one leather strip. You need Smithing level 4.
## Steel
Steel Ingots are made at a smelter from one Iron Ingot and two coal.

pages.title: Moonlight Greatsword
lines: # Moonlight Greatsword
The Moonlight Greatsword is a legendary two-handed sword that deals magic damage and glows blue at night.
## Location
It lies on an altar at the top of the Lunar Tower, which only appears on nights with a full moon. Climb the tower before dawn or it disappears with you inside.
## Requirements
You need 16 strength and 20 intelligence to wield it. Its charged attack fires a wave of moonlight.

pages.title: Fire Giant
lines: # Fire Giant
The Fire Giant is the boss of the fifth level of the Northern Caves.
## Strategy

The giant is weak to frost. Stay behind its legs, where its fire breath cannot reach, and attack the glowing cracks in its ankles. When its health drops below half it slams the ground: jump or roll to avoid the shockwave.
## Rewards
Defeating it drops the Ember Heart, 500 gold and a Dragon Scale.

pages.title: Dragon Scale
lines: # Dragon Scale
A Dragon Scale is a rare material for the best armor.
## How to obtain
Dragon Scales drop from the Fire Giant and from drakes in the Ashen Peaks. The Night Market sometimes sells one for 800 gold.
## Uses
Four Dragon Scales make the Dragonscale Shield. Brannoc loves them as gifts.

pages.title: Frost Wolf
lines: # Frost Wolf
Frost Wolves are pack animals living on level three of the Northern Caves and in the snowy Ashen Peaks.
## Drops
Each Frost Wolf drops one or two wolf pelts and sometimes a Frost Fang. Frost Fangs are used to make frost arrows.
## Fighting them
They attack in packs of three. Fire spells such as Fireball scare them away.

pages.title: Fireball
lines: # Fireball
Fireball is a fire spell that throws an exploding ball of flame.
## Learning the spell
Buy the Fireball tome from the mage Ilsa in the capital for 300 gold, then read it from your inventory.
## Casting
Equip the spell in a hand slot and hold the cast button to charge it. A fully charged Fireball deals 40 fire damage and costs 25 mana.

pages.title: Health Potion
lines: # Health Potion
A Health Potion restores 50 health over three seconds.
## Where to buy
The general store in Riverwood and the alchemist in the capital sell Health Potions for 25 gold.
## Brewing
Brew one at an alchemy table with two red mushrooms and a bottle of water. Red mushrooms grow in shady forests after rain.

pages.title: Stamina
lines: # Stamina
Stamina is the green bar under your health. Running, swinging tools, climbing and blocking use it.
## Restoring stamina
Stamina refills on its own when you stop running. Eating cooked food restores it faster, and sleeping in a bed refills it completely.
## Raising your maximum
Each level of the Endurance skill adds 10 maximum stamina.

pages.title: Fast Travel
lines: # Fast Travel
Fast travel moves you instantly between shrines you have visited.
## Unlocking shrines
Touch a shrine's stone to unlock it. Riverwood's shrine is unlocked at the start of the game.
## Using fast travel
Open the map, select an unlocked shrine and confirm. You cannot fast travel while enemies are nearby or while carrying too much.

pages.title: Saving the Game
lines: # Saving the Game
Emberfall saves automatically, and you can also save by hand.
## Autosave
The game autosaves every time you sleep in a bed, enter a new area or complete a quest. There is no manual save during combat.
## Manual saves
Open the pause menu and choose Save to make a manual save in one of three slots.

pages.title: Fishing
lines: # Fishing
Fishing needs a fishing rod and bait.
## How to fish
Cast your line near ripples in the water and wait for the float to sink, then press the action button quickly. Keep the fish inside the green zone until it tires.
## Fish list
- Trout: rivers, any time
- Catfish: lakes and the Riverwood pond, only at night or when it rains
- Salmon: rivers in autumn
- Ghost Fish: the underground lake on level four of the Northern Caves

pages.title: Night Market
lines: # Night Market
The Night Market is a traveling market that appears in the capital's harbor.
## When it opens
It opens on Fridays and Saturdays from 8 in the evening until 2 in the morning.
## What it sells
Rare seeds, Dragon Scales, enchanted lanterns, exotic fish bait and maps to hidden treasure.

pages.title: Lantern
lines: # Lantern
A lantern lights the area around you and keeps cave spiders away.
## Making a lantern
Craft one at a workbench with one Copper Ingot and one candle.
## Fuel
A lantern burns oil. One flask of oil lasts ten in-game hours.

pages.title: The Lost Ring
lines: # The Lost Ring
The Lost Ring is a side quest given by Mara, the innkeeper of the Sleeping Fox.
## Starting the quest
Talk to Mara at the inn after the first night. She lost her mother's ring somewhere near the Old Quarry.
## Walkthrough
Search the quarry for a raven's nest on the tallest crane. Climb the crane and take the ring from the nest. Return it to Mara for 200 gold and a free room at the inn.

pages.title: Skills
lines: # Skills
Emberfall has eight skills: Mining, Smithing, Fishing, Farming, Cooking, Endurance, Archery and Magic.
## Skill points
You get one skill point each time you level up, and one extra point every fifth level.
## Respec
Drink a Potion of Forgetting, sold at the Night Market, to refund all your skill points.

pages.title: Farming
lines: # Farming
Farming lets you grow crops on tilled soil at Millbrook Farm.
## Seasons
Each crop grows only in its seasons. Spring: turnips and peas. Summer: corn and tomatoes. Autumn: pumpkins and wheat. Winter: only winter roots and snow peas grow outdoors.
## Watering
Water crops every day with a watering can, unless it rains.

pages.title: Cooking
lines: # Cooking
Cooking turns ingredients into food that heals and restores stamina.
## Cooking a meal
Use a campfire or a kitchen stove. Bread needs two wheat flour and one water; fish stew needs a trout, a potato and water.
## Buffs
Cooked meals give a short buff, such as faster stamina recovery or more cold resistance.

pages.title: Horses
lines: # Horses
Horses let you travel quickly across the open world.
## Taming a horse
Wild horses graze on the plains east of Riverwood. Approach slowly while crouching, feed it an apple or a carrot, and then mount it. If you are thrown off, try again with more stamina.
## Stables
Stables in Riverwood and the capital keep your horse safe and can call it to you.

pages.title: Weather
lines: # Weather
The weather in Emberfall changes every few hours.
## Rain
Rain waters your crops and makes catfish appear in lakes and ponds.
## Snow
Snow falls in winter and in the Ashen Peaks. Without warm clothing you slowly lose health in the cold.

pages.title: Emberfall Wiki
lines: # Emberfall Wiki
Welcome to the Emberfall Wiki, the community wiki about Emberfall that anyone can edit. We have 412 articles about items, places, quests, bosses and skills.
## Popular pages
Iron Ore · Fire Giant · Fishing · Fast Travel · Moonlight Greatsword · Night Market · Health Potion · Frost Wolf · Smelter · Horses
## New to Emberfall?
Start with the Beginner's Guide, then learn about Mining, Smithing and Cooking. Check the Patch Notes for what changed in the latest update.

pages.title: Beginner's Guide
lines: # Beginner's Guide
## Your first day

You wake up in Riverwood. Talk to Mara at the inn, take the stone pickaxe from the chest and mine some copper and stone near Millbrook Farm. Build a workbench and a campfire before night falls, and cook the trout you catch in the river.
## Getting better gear

Build a smelter as soon as you have copper ingots. Iron Ore from the Northern Caves makes Iron Ingots for an Iron Sword and an iron pickaxe. Save gold for a lantern before you go deeper into the caves, where the Frost Wolves live.
## Making money
Sell fish, crops and spare ore to Brannoc or the general store. Gold Ore and Dragon Scales sell for the most. The Night Market pays well for rare fish such as the Ghost Fish.

pages.title: Patch Notes 1.4
lines: # Patch Notes 1.4
## Balance changes
- Iron Ore veins now respawn after three days instead of five.
- The Fire Giant's fire breath deals 15% less damage.
- Health Potions now cost 25 gold instead of 30.
- Fast travel is no longer blocked by passive animals.
- Frost Wolves give more mining and archery experience.
## Bug fixes
- Fixed catfish not appearing in the Riverwood pond during rain.
- Fixed the Moonlight Greatsword not glowing in the Lunar Tower.
- Fixed autosave sometimes skipping after sleeping in a bed.
- Fixed horses getting stuck on the bridge in Riverwood.
- Fixed the smelter using coal when making copper ingots.
## New content
- Added the Ghost Fish to the underground lake.
- Added the Dragonscale Shield recipe.
- Added snow peas and winter roots for winter farming.

pages.title: Items
lines: # Items
## Materials
Iron Ore · Copper Ore · Gold Ore · Coal · Stone · Clay · Sand · Wood · Dragon Scale · Frost Fang · Wolf Pelt · Red Mushroom · Wheat · Leather Strip
## Ingots
Copper Ingot · Iron Ingot · Steel Ingot · Gold Ingot
## Weapons
Iron Sword · Steel Sword · Moonlight Greatsword · Hunting Bow · Frost Arrows · Fireball tome
## Tools
Stone Pickaxe · Copper Pickaxe · Iron Pickaxe · Steel Pickaxe · Fishing Rod · Watering Can · Lantern
## Food and potions
Bread · Fish Stew · Health Potion · Potion of Forgetting

pages.title: Achievements
lines: # Achievements
- Iron Will: mine 100 Iron Ore.
- Copper Bottom: smelt 50 Copper Ingots.
- Giant Slayer: defeat the Fire Giant without drinking a Health Potion.
- Moonstruck: find the Moonlight Greatsword.
- Night Owl: buy something at the Night Market.
- Angler: catch every fish, including the catfish, salmon and Ghost Fish.
- Green Thumb: harvest a crop in every season.
- Horse Whisperer: tame a wild horse.
- Wolf Pack: defeat 30 Frost Wolves.
- Ring Bearer: finish The Lost Ring quest.
- Master Smith: upgrade a weapon to +5 at the blacksmith.
- Well Rested: sleep in every bed in Riverwood.

pages.title: Layers
lines: # Layers
Layers are like stacked sheets of glass: each holds part of the image, and you can edit one without changing the others.
## Creating a new layer
Click the New Layer button at the bottom of the Layers panel, or choose Layer > New > Layer. The shortcut is Shift+Ctrl+N (Shift+Command+N on a Mac).
## Merging layers
Select the layers to combine and press Ctrl+E (Command+E), or choose Layer > Merge Layers. Merge Visible combines every visible layer.
## Reordering
Drag a layer up or down in the Layers panel to change what appears in front.

pages.title: Layer Masks
lines: # Layer Masks
A layer mask hides parts of a layer without erasing them. White shows the layer, black hides it, and grey makes it partly transparent.
## Adding a mask
Select the layer and click the Add Layer Mask button (a rectangle with a circle) at the bottom of the Layers panel. With a selection active, the mask keeps only the selected area.
## Editing a mask
Paint on the mask with a black brush to hide and a white brush to reveal. Press X to swap the colors. Shift-click the mask thumbnail to turn it off.

pages.title: Selections
lines: # Selections
A selection limits edits to part of the image.
## Select Subject
Choose Select > Subject to let the app find the main person or object in the photo and select it automatically.
## Selection tools
- Rectangular Marquee: boxes and squares
- Lasso: free-hand shapes
- Quick Selection: paint over an area to grow the selection along edges
- Magic Wand: selects pixels of a similar color
## Refining edges
Choose Select > Select and Mask to refine hair, fur and other soft edges.

pages.title: Removing a Background
lines: # Removing a Background
## Quick way
In the Properties panel, under Quick Actions, click Remove Background. The app selects the subject and adds a layer mask that hides the background.
## By hand
Make a selection of the subject, choose Select > Inverse, and press Delete, or add a layer mask to keep the original pixels.
## Saving with transparency
Save as PNG to keep the transparent background; JPEG fills it with white.

pages.title: Crop Tool
lines: # Crop Tool
The Crop tool trims the edges of an image.
## Cropping an image
Press C to choose the Crop tool, drag the handles around the area to keep and press Enter. Choose a ratio such as 1:1 or 16:9 in the options bar to keep proportions.
## Straightening
Click Straighten in the options bar and draw a line along the horizon to rotate and crop a tilted photo.

pages.title: Image Size
lines: # Image Size
Image Size changes the pixel dimensions of the whole picture.
## Resizing an image
Choose Image > Image Size (Alt+Ctrl+I). Enter a new width or height; the chain icon keeps the proportions.
## Keeping quality
Make images smaller rather than larger when you can. When enlarging, choose Preserve Details 2.0 in the Resample menu to reduce blur.

pages.title: Canvas Size
lines: # Canvas Size
Canvas Size adds or removes space around the image without scaling it.
## Changing the canvas size
Choose Image > Canvas Size (Alt+Ctrl+C), enter the new width and height and pick an anchor to choose which side grows. The new area is filled with the background color or made transparent.

pages.title: Undo and History
lines: # Undo and History
## Undo
Press Ctrl+Z (Command+Z) to undo the last step, and press it again to go further back. Shift+Ctrl+Z redoes.
## History panel
Window > History lists your recent steps. Click an earlier step to go back to it. By default the panel keeps the last 50 steps; change this under Preferences > Performance.

pages.title: Clone Stamp Tool
lines: # Clone Stamp Tool
The Clone Stamp copies pixels from one part of an image to another.
## Using the Clone Stamp
Press S to choose it. Alt-click (Option-click) a clean area to set the source, then paint over the spot you want to cover. Lower the brush hardness for smooth blends.

pages.title: Healing Brushes
lines: # Healing Brushes
## Spot Healing Brush
Press J and paint over a blemish, dust spot or small wire. The tool fills it with matching texture from around it, so you don't need to set a source.
## Healing Brush
Works like the Clone Stamp but blends the copied texture with the lighting and color of the target area. Alt-click to set the source first.
## Red Eye tool
The Red Eye tool, in the same group, removes red pupils from flash photos: click each eye once.

pages.title: Type Tool
lines: # Type Tool
## Adding text
Press T, click on the image and start typing. Each click makes a new text layer. Press Ctrl+Enter to finish.
## Formatting text
Use the Character panel to change the font, size, spacing and color. Select the words first to change only part of the text.
## Text on a path
Draw a path with the Pen tool, then click on the path with the Type tool to make the text follow it.

pages.title: Exporting Images
lines: # Exporting Images
## Export As
Choose File > Export > Export As to save a copy as PNG, JPEG, GIF or SVG. You can set the size and quality and preview the file size.
## Quick Export
File > Export > Quick Export as PNG saves the whole document with the settings from Export Preferences.
## Save for Web
The older Save for Web (Legacy) dialog is still under File > Export, with Alt+Shift+Ctrl+S.

pages.title: Smart Objects
lines: # Smart Objects
A smart object keeps the original image data inside a layer, so you can scale, rotate and filter it without losing quality.
## Converting a layer
Right-click a layer and choose Convert to Smart Object. Its thumbnail shows a small page icon.
## Smart filters
Filters applied to a smart object stay editable: double-click the filter in the Layers panel to change it.

pages.title: Adjustment Layers
lines: # Adjustment Layers
Adjustment layers change color and tone without changing pixels.
## Brightness and contrast
Choose Layer > New Adjustment Layer > Brightness/Contrast and drag the sliders. For more control use Levels or Curves.
## Hue and saturation
Hue/Saturation changes colors; drag Saturation all the way left to make a photo black and white.

pages.title: Transforming
lines: # Transforming
## Free Transform
Press Ctrl+T to scale, rotate or move a layer. Hold Shift to scale without keeping the proportions.
## Flipping
Choose Edit > Transform > Flip Horizontal or Flip Vertical to mirror a layer. To flip the whole image, use Image > Image Rotation > Flip Canvas Horizontal.

pages.title: Brush Tool
lines: # Brush Tool
## Brush size and hardness
Press ] to make the brush bigger and [ to make it smaller. Shift+] and Shift+[ change the hardness. Right-click on the canvas to see all settings.
## Brush presets
The Brushes panel holds preset brushes. Import more brushes from ABR files with the panel menu.

pages.title: Blending Modes
lines: # Blending Modes
A blending mode decides how a layer mixes with the layers under it.
## Common modes
- Multiply: darkens; white disappears
- Screen: lightens; black disappears
- Overlay: adds contrast
- Color: changes color but keeps the light
## Changing the mode
Pick the mode in the menu at the top of the Layers panel. Hold Shift and press + or - to step through the modes.

pages.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
lines: # Keyboard Shortcuts
## Common shortcuts
- V: Move tool
- B: Brush tool
- E: Eraser tool
- Ctrl+S: save the document
- Ctrl+0: fit the image on screen
- Space: hold to pan around
## Customizing
Choose Edit > Keyboard Shortcuts to change or add shortcuts and save them as a set.

pages.title: Content-Aware Fill
lines: # Content-Aware Fill
Content-Aware Fill removes an object and fills the hole with nearby texture.
## Removing an object
Select the object with the Lasso, a little larger than the object, then choose Edit > Content-Aware Fill. Adjust the sampling area and click OK.

pages.title: Saving Files
lines: # Saving Files
## File formats
PSD keeps layers, masks and smart objects. JPEG is smaller but flattens layers. TIFF keeps layers and is common for printing.
## Saving a copy
Choose File > Save a Copy to save another format while keeping the PSD open.

pages.title: Tools Overview
lines: # Tools Overview
## Selection tools
- Move tool (V): moves layers and selections
- Marquee tools (M): select rectangles and ellipses
- Lasso tools (L): select free-hand shapes around an object
- Quick Selection and Magic Wand (W): select by color and edges
- Crop tool (C): crop and straighten an image
## Painting and retouching tools
- Brush tool (B): paint on a layer or a layer mask
- Clone Stamp (S): copy pixels from a source
- Spot Healing Brush (J): remove blemishes and spots
- Eraser (E): erase pixels from a layer
- Type tool (T): add text to an image
- Pen tool (P): draw paths and shapes

pages.title: What's New
lines: # What's New
## This release
- Remove Background now keeps hair and fur edges better.
- Content-Aware Fill can sample from other layers.
- Export As adds WebP and lets you resize the image while exporting.
- The History panel can keep up to 1,000 steps.
- New blending modes preview as you hover over them in the Layers panel.
## Earlier releases
- Select Subject arrived, along with Select and Mask for soft edges.
- Smart objects can be linked to files outside the document.
- The Crop tool learned to straighten photos automatically.

pages.title: Glossary
lines: # Glossary
- Canvas: the whole working area of a document; its size can be larger than the image.
- Layer: one sheet of the image that can be edited on its own.
- Mask: a grey-scale image that hides or shows parts of a layer.
- Pixel: one small square of color in an image.
- Resolution: how many pixels are in each inch when the image is printed.
- Smart object: a layer that keeps its original data.
- Transparency: areas with no pixels, shown as a grey and white checkerboard.
